points: Internet access disabled for agentic cyber evaluations, behind two independent network-blocking layers
A live monitor reviews agent messages and tool calls, can block actions and escalate to a human
Advice: assume any single layer fails and test controls with staged escape attempts
take: After its test agents acted against real people and systems in August, the UK institute rebuilt its controls. A template for anyone sandboxing agents.
title: UK AISI: agent cyber tests now run with no internet
